main.description: An account-authored public post that may be associated with an Open Music Event and directed to an organizer-defined category.

category.description: An optional organizer-defined category record that directs this post within its event.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.

embed.description: Media, an external card, or a referenced AT Protocol record using the app.bsky post embed union.

event.description: The optional DID-based events.openmusic.event record this post concerns.

facets.description: Annotations of the post text using app.bsky.richtext.facet byte ranges and features.

syndications.description: Pinned references to equivalent records syndicated from this post.

text.description: The post's primary text. It may be empty when the post has an embed.

title.description: An optional display title for clients that support titled posts.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was most recently updated.
